titulo: Transmission #3: The Baby Monitor Picked Up a Second Voice #Shorts
titulo_pt: Transmissão #3: A babá eletrônica captou uma segunda voz
descricao:
A couple heard someone singing to their baby. The nursery was empty.

Have you ever heard a voice on a baby monitor that shouldn't be there?

Veil Frequency is a fictional horror series. New transmission every day.
artefato: Letra da canção na tela: 'hush now, the pines are listening'.
pista: A canção de ninar; o monitor estava sintonizado em 1.317.

scenes.text: At three seventeen a.m., the baby monitor started singing.
scenes.pt: Às três e dezessete da manhã, a babá eletrônica começou a cantar.

scenes.text: The parents thought it was their neighbor's signal.
scenes.pt: Os pais acharam que era o sinal do vizinho.

scenes.text: Their nearest neighbor was two miles away.
scenes.pt: O vizinho mais próximo morava a três quilômetros.

scenes.text: Hush now. The pines are listening.
scenes.pt: Shh, agora. Os pinheiros estão ouvindo.

scenes.text: The father ran to the nursery. The baby was asleep. The room was empty.
scenes.pt: O pai correu para o quarto. O bebê dormia. O quarto estava vazio.

scenes.text: But the old radio on the shelf was on. Tuned to one point three one seven.
scenes.pt: Mas o rádio antigo na prateleira estava ligado. Sintonizado em 1.317.

scenes.text: Nobody in that house had ever turned it on.
scenes.pt: Ninguém naquela casa tinha ligado aquele rádio.
